blocks.html: Exciting prizes are up for grabs daily in Win Shopping Money Every day, the newest proof-of-purchase promo of Robinsons Place Gen Trias. Daily raffle draws will yield five lucky winners of Php 2000 worth of Robinsons Gift Certificates (transferrable but not convertible to cash). Shoppers with a minimum purchase of Php 500 single receipt from any Robinsons Place Gen Trias stores and restaurants, or customers with a Php 1000 single receipt purchase from Supermarket and Robinsons Appliances can join the promo. To join, interested participants must present their receipt at the promo redemption booth for validation. Customers’ complete name, age, complete home address, contact number and signature must be written at the back of it and must be drop at designated drop box located at the ground floor of Robinsons Place Gen Trias. Cut-off time for dropping of raffle entries is 7pm and will resume after the draw has been made. Meanwhile, the Winners will be notified via registered mail and through a phone call or text 2-3 days after the draw. List of weekly winners will be announced via mall posters and through Robinsons Place Gen Trias Facebook.
